# PamgeneAnalyzeR example pipeline

## Load example data
```{r, include=TRUE}
library(pamgeneAnalyzeR)
library(tiff)
```

```{r helpers, include=TRUE}
repo_root <- NULL
for (candidate in c(".", "..")) {
  candidate_path <- normalizePath(candidate, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  if (file.exists(file.path(candidate_path, "data", "raw", "Kerthi_HDV_Aug24"))) {
    repo_root <- candidate_path
    break
  }
}

if (is.null(repo_root)) {
  stop("Could not locate the repository root from the current working directory.")
}

repo_path <- function(...) {
  file.path(repo_root, ...)
}

load_tiff_as_matrix <- function(path) {
  img <- tiff::readTIFF(path)
  # pamgeneAnalyzeR checks for the exact class "matrix".
  structure(unclass(img), class = "matrix")
}

read_layout_table <- function(path) {
  read.table(
    file = path,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    comment.char = ""
  )
}

safe_plot_image_from_signal <- function(signal) {
  signal_plot <- subset(signal, is.finite(x) & is.finite(y) & is.finite(median))

  if (!nrow(signal_plot)) {
    stop("No finite x/y/median values available for plotting.")
  }

  g <- min(signal_plot$median, na.rm = TRUE) / max(signal_plot$median, na.rm = TRUE)
  g <- max(0, min(1, g))
  background_color <- grey(g)

  ggplot2::ggplot(signal_plot, ggplot2::aes(x = y, y = x, color = median)) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_reverse() +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 15) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_gradientn(colours = c(background_color, "white")) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_rect(fill = background_color),
      panel.grid = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.line = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.title.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.border = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.background = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )
}

save_signal_plot <- function(signal, filename, width = 5, height = 4, dpi = 150) {
  plot_path <- file.path(plot_dir, filename)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = plot_path,
    plot = safe_plot_image_from_signal(signal),
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = dpi,
    bg = "white"
  )
  plot_path
}

save_base_plot <- function(filename, expr, width = 7, height = 7, res = 150) {
  expr <- substitute(expr)
  plot_path <- file.path(plot_dir, filename)
  grDevices::png(
    filename = plot_path,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    units = "in",
    res = res,
    bg = "white"
  )
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off(), add = TRUE)
  eval(expr, envir = parent.frame())
  plot_path
}

plot_registration_check <- function(source, target, nLevels = 4,
                                    maxIterations = 5, useBlockPercentage = 50) {
  transform <- RNiftyReg::niftyreg(
    source,
    target,
    scope = "rigid",
    nLevels = nLevels,
    maxIterations = maxIterations,
    useBlockPercentage = useBlockPercentage
  )
  kernel <- mmand::shapeKernel(c(3, 3))
  gradient <- mmand::dilate(transform$image, kernel) - mmand::erode(transform$image, kernel)
  edges <- mmand::threshold(gradient, method = "kmeans")

  plot(imager::as.cimg(t(target)))
  edge_points <- which(edges > 0, arr.ind = TRUE)
  points(edge_points[, 2], edge_points[, 1], col = "red", pch = ".")
}

show_saved_images <- function(paths, width = "48%") {
  html <- paste(
    vapply(
      paths,
      function(path) {
        sprintf(
          '<img src="%s" style="width:%s; margin-right:1%%; margin-bottom:12px;" />',
          knitr::image_uri(path),
          width
        )
      },
      character(1)
    ),
    collapse = "\n"
  )
  knitr::asis_output(html)
}

build_row_key <- function(df, cols) {
  do.call(
    paste,
    c(
      lapply(df[cols], function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "<NA>", as.character(x))),
      sep = "||"
    )
  )
}

assert_required_columns <- function(df, required_cols, df_name) {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))
  if (length(missing_cols)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "%s is missing required columns: %s",
      df_name,
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
}

assert_complete_columns <- function(df, cols, df_name) {
  assert_required_columns(df, cols, df_name)
  incomplete_rows <- !stats::complete.cases(df[cols])
  if (any(incomplete_rows)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "%s has %d incomplete rows for columns: %s",
      df_name,
      sum(incomplete_rows),
      paste(cols, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
}

report_incomplete_columns <- function(df, cols, df_name) {
  present_cols <- cols[cols %in% names(df)]
  if (!length(present_cols)) {
    return(invisible(NULL))
  }

  missing_counts <- vapply(
    present_cols,
    function(col) sum(is.na(df[[col]])),
    integer(1)
  )
  missing_counts <- missing_counts[missing_counts > 0]

  if (length(missing_counts)) {
    message(
      sprintf(
        "%s contains missing values: %s",
        df_name,
        paste(
          sprintf("%s=%d", names(missing_counts), missing_counts),
          collapse = ", "
        )
      )
    )
  }

  invisible(missing_counts)
}

assert_unique_keys <- function(df, key_cols, df_name) {
  key_values <- build_row_key(df, key_cols)
  duplicated_rows <- duplicated(key_values)
  if (any(duplicated_rows)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "%s contains duplicated keys for: %s",
      df_name,
      paste(key_cols, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }
}

assert_same_key_counts <- function(reference_df, candidate_df, key_cols,
                                   reference_name, candidate_name) {
  reference_keys <- table(build_row_key(reference_df, key_cols))
  candidate_keys <- table(build_row_key(candidate_df, key_cols))

  missing_keys <- setdiff(names(reference_keys), names(candidate_keys))
  extra_keys <- setdiff(names(candidate_keys), names(reference_keys))
  shared_keys <- intersect(names(reference_keys), names(candidate_keys))
  mismatched_counts <- shared_keys[reference_keys[shared_keys] != candidate_keys[shared_keys]]

  if (length(missing_keys) || length(extra_keys) || length(mismatched_counts)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      paste(
        "%s and %s do not contain the same row keys.",
        "Missing in %s: %d.",
        "Extra in %s: %d.",
        "Different multiplicities: %d."
      ),
      reference_name,
      candidate_name,
      candidate_name,
      length(missing_keys),
      candidate_name,
      length(extra_keys),
      length(mismatched_counts)
    ))
  }
}

parse_pamgene_filename <- function(path) {
  filename <- basename(path)
  matches <- regmatches(
    filename,
    regexec("^([0-9]+)_W([0-9]+)_F([0-9]+)_T([0-9]+)_P([0-9]+)_I([0-9]+)_A([0-9]+)\\.(tif|txt)$", filename)
  )[[1]]

  if (!length(matches)) {
    stop(sprintf("Could not parse image filename: %s", filename))
  }

  data.frame(
    Barcode = as.integer(matches[2]),
    Row = as.integer(matches[3]),
    FoV = as.integer(matches[4]),
    Exposure.Time = as.integer(matches[5]),
    Cycle = as.integer(matches[6]),
    Image_number = as.integer(matches[7]),
    Temperature = as.integer(matches[8]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

negative_control_names <- c(
  "right_background1", "right_background2",
  "left_background1", "left_background2",
  "top_background1", "top_background2",
  "bottom_background1", "bottom_background2"
)

positive_control_names <- c(
  "control_right1", "control_right2", "control_right3", "control_right4",
  "control_left1", "control_left2", "control_left3", "control_left4"
)

mixed_levels_base <- function(values) {
  values_chr <- as.character(values)
  unique_values <- unique(values_chr)
  unique_numeric <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(sub("^.*?([0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]+)?).*$", "\\1", unique_values))
  )
  unique_values[order(is.na(unique_numeric), unique_numeric, unique_values)]
}

resolve_spot_labels <- function(df) {
  labels <- df$ID
  use_names <- (is.na(labels) | labels == "#REF") & !is.na(df$names) & df$names != ""
  labels[use_names] <- df$names[use_names]
  labels
}

merge_experiments_compatible <- function(path, pattern = NULL, value = "median") {
  batch <- sort(dir(path = path, pattern = pattern))
  d <- NULL

  for (filename in batch) {
    pam <- pamgeneObject(file = file.path(path, filename))
    labels <- resolve_spot_labels(pam$data)
    keep <- !is.na(labels) & labels != "#REF"
    tmp <- pam$data[keep, value]
    names(tmp) <- labels[keep]
    d <- rbind(
      d,
      data.frame(
        chipID = pam$chipID,
        well = pam$well,
        cycle = pam$cycle,
        exposureTime = pam$exposureTime,
        t(tmp),
        check.names = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  d$cycle <- factor(as.character(d$cycle), levels = mixed_levels_base(d$cycle))
  d$exposureTime <- factor(
    as.character(d$exposureTime),
    levels = mixed_levels_base(d$exposureTime)
  )
  d
}

subtract_background_compatible <- function(rawData) {
  pheno_cols <- intersect(c("chipID", "well", "exposureTime", "cycle", "ZpFactor"), names(rawData))
  signal_cols <- setdiff(names(rawData), pheno_cols)
  missing_negative_controls <- setdiff(negative_control_names, signal_cols)

  if (length(missing_negative_controls)) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "rawData is missing negative control columns: %s",
      paste(missing_negative_controls, collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  signal_df <- rawData[signal_cols]
  negative_means <- rowMeans(rawData[negative_control_names], na.rm = FALSE)
  normalized_signal <- as.data.frame(
    sweep(as.matrix(signal_df), 1, negative_means, FUN = "-"),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  data.frame(rawData[pheno_cols], normalized_signal, check.names = FALSE)
}

run_pamgene_pipeline <- function(image_dir, out_dir, target, centers.coords, layout,
                                 radius = 5, overwrite = FALSE, verbose = TRUE) {
  tif_files <- sort(list.files(image_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE))
  dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  txt_files <- sort(list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE))
  expected_txt_files <- sub("\\.tif$", ".txt", basename(tif_files))

  rerun_pipeline <- overwrite || !setequal(basename(txt_files), expected_txt_files)

  if (rerun_pipeline) {
    if (length(txt_files)) {
      unlink(txt_files)
    }
    if (verbose) {
      cat("Running registerAllImages for", basename(out_dir), "...\n")
    }
    registerAllImages(
      inDirectory = image_dir,
      outDirectory = out_dir,
      target = target,
      centers.coords = centers.coords,
      radius = radius,
      parallel.sig.extract = FALSE,
      parallel.registration = FALSE,
      pamgene.layout.file = layout
    )
  } else if (verbose) {
    cat("Using existing PamGeneAnalyzeR TXT files in", out_dir, "\n")
  }

  txt_files <- sort(list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE))
  if (!setequal(basename(txt_files), expected_txt_files)) {
    stop(sprintf("registerAllImages did not generate the expected TXT files in %s", out_dir))
  }

  txt_files
}

wide_metric_to_long <- function(df, value_name) {
  pheno_cols <- intersect(c("chipID", "well", "exposureTime", "cycle", "ZpFactor"), names(df))
  signal_cols <- setdiff(names(df), pheno_cols)

  long_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(signal_cols, function(signal_col) {
      tmp <- df[pheno_cols]
      tmp$ID <- signal_col
      tmp[[value_name]] <- df[[signal_col]]
      tmp
    })
  )

  long_df$Barcode <- as.integer(long_df$chipID)
  long_df$Row <- as.integer(sub("^W", "", as.character(long_df$well)))
  long_df$Exposure.Time <- as.integer(sub("^T", "", as.character(long_df$exposureTime)))
  long_df$Cycle <- as.integer(sub("^P", "", as.character(long_df$cycle)))
  long_df
}

build_pamgene_export_from_pipeline <- function(out_dir, reference_df, output_path = NULL) {
  required_reference_cols <- c(
    "image_idx", "Barcode", "Row", "spotRow", "spotCol", "Exposure.Time",
    "Cycle", "ID", "Sequence", "I_median", "Intensity", "MaxIntensity",
    "FoV", "Image_number", "Temperature"
  )
  reference_key_cols <- c(
    "image_idx", "Barcode", "Row", "spotRow", "spotCol", "Exposure.Time", "Cycle",
    "FoV", "Image_number", "Temperature", "ID", "Sequence"
  )
  metric_cols <- c("I_median", "Intensity", "MaxIntensity", "Signal_Saturation")
  image_join_cols <- c(
    "Barcode", "Row", "FoV", "Exposure.Time", "Cycle", "Image_number", "Temperature"
  )

  assert_required_columns(reference_df, required_reference_cols, "reference_df")
  assert_complete_columns(reference_df, required_reference_cols, "reference_df")

  txt_files <- sort(list.files(out_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE))
  if (!length(txt_files)) {
    stop(sprintf("No PamGeneAnalyzeR TXT files found in %s", out_dir))
  }

  image_lookup <- unique(reference_df[c("image_idx", image_join_cols)])
  assert_unique_keys(image_lookup, image_join_cols, "image_lookup")

  raw_txt_df <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(txt_files, function(file) {
      meta <- parse_pamgene_filename(file)
      df <- read.delim(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      df <- df[df$Row > 0 & df$Col > 0, , drop = FALSE]
      resolved_ids <- resolve_spot_labels(df)
      keep <- !is.na(resolved_ids) & resolved_ids != "#REF"
      df <- df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
      df$ID <- resolved_ids[keep]
      df$spotRow <- df$Row
      df$spotCol <- df$Col
      df$Barcode <- meta$Barcode
      df$Row <- meta$Row
      df$FoV <- meta$FoV
      df$Exposure.Time <- meta$Exposure.Time
      df$Cycle <- meta$Cycle
      df$Image_number <- meta$Image_number
      df$Temperature <- meta$Temperature
      df$Intensity <- df$sum
      df$MaxIntensity <- df$max
      df$Signal_Saturation <- NA_real_
      df
    })
  )

  raw_image_keys <- unique(build_row_key(raw_txt_df, image_join_cols))
  raw_txt_df <- merge(
    raw_txt_df,
    image_lookup,
    by = image_join_cols,
    all = FALSE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  matched_image_keys <- unique(build_row_key(raw_txt_df, image_join_cols))
  skipped_images <- setdiff(raw_image_keys, matched_image_keys)
  if (length(skipped_images)) {
    message(
      sprintf(
        "Skipping %d PamGene image(s) from %s that are not present in reference_df.",
        length(skipped_images),
        basename(out_dir)
      )
    )
  }
  assert_complete_columns(raw_txt_df, "image_idx", "PamGene image metadata merge")
  assert_unique_keys(raw_txt_df, reference_key_cols, "raw PamGene TXT rows")
  report_incomplete_columns(
    raw_txt_df,
    c("Intensity", "MaxIntensity"),
    sprintf("raw PamGene TXT rows from %s", basename(out_dir))
  )

  median_wide <- merge_experiments_compatible(path = out_dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", value = "median")
  median_bg <- subtract_background_compatible(median_wide)
  median_long <- wide_metric_to_long(median_bg, "I_median")
  median_long <- median_long[c("Barcode", "Row", "Exposure.Time", "Cycle", "ID", "I_median")]
  assert_unique_keys(
    median_long,
    c("Barcode", "Row", "Exposure.Time", "Cycle", "ID"),
    "PamGene median values"
  )

  out_df <- merge(
    raw_txt_df,
    median_long,
    by = c("Barcode", "Row", "Exposure.Time", "Cycle", "ID"),
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  assert_same_key_counts(
    reference_df = raw_txt_df,
    candidate_df = out_df,
    key_cols = reference_key_cols,
    reference_name = "raw PamGene TXT rows",
    candidate_name = "PamGene median merge"
  )
  report_incomplete_columns(out_df, "I_median", "PamGene median merge")

  metric_df <- out_df[c(reference_key_cols, intersect(metric_cols, names(out_df)))]
  reference_base <- reference_df[setdiff(names(reference_df), metric_cols)]
  out_df <- merge(
    reference_base,
    metric_df,
    by = reference_key_cols,
    all.x = TRUE,
    sort = FALSE
  )
  assert_same_key_counts(
    reference_df = reference_df,
    candidate_df = out_df,
    key_cols = reference_key_cols,
    reference_name = "reference_df",
    candidate_name = "PamGeneAnalyzeR export"
  )

  reference_cols <- names(reference_df)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(reference_cols, names(out_df))
  for (col in missing_cols) {
    out_df[[col]] <- NA
  }

  out_df <- out_df[reference_cols]
  out_df <- out_df[order(
    out_df$Barcode,
    out_df$Row,
    out_df$spotRow,
    out_df$spotCol,
    out_df$Exposure.Time,
    out_df$Cycle
  ), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out_df) <- NULL
  report_incomplete_columns(
    out_df,
    c("I_median", "Intensity", "MaxIntensity", "Signal_Saturation"),
    "PamGeneAnalyzeR export"
  )

  if (!is.null(output_path)) {
    dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    write.csv(out_df, output_path, row.names = FALSE)
  }

  out_df
}

compare_pykinaxe_vs_pamgene <- function(py_df, pam_df, output_path = NULL) {
  metric_candidates <- intersect(
    c("I_median", "Intensity", "MaxIntensity", "Signal_Saturation"),
    intersect(names(py_df), names(pam_df))
  )
  preferred_key_cols <- c(
    "image_idx", "Barcode", "Row", "spotRow", "spotCol", "Exposure.Time",
    "Cycle", "FoV", "Image_number", "Temperature", "ID", "Sequence",
    "PepProtein_SeqMatch", "PepProtein_UniprotName", "PepProtein_UniprotID",
    "entrezid", "PepProtein_SeqSimilarity", "Enr_family", "Enr_chip_num"
  )
  key_cols <- preferred_key_cols[preferred_key_cols %in% names(py_df) & preferred_key_cols %in% names(pam_df)]

  assert_same_key_counts(
    reference_df = py_df,
    candidate_df = pam_df,
    key_cols = key_cols,
    reference_name = "pyKinaXe results",
    candidate_name = "PamGeneAnalyzeR results"
  )

  metric_cols <- metric_candidates[
    vapply(
      metric_candidates,
      function(metric) {
        any(!is.na(py_df[[metric]])) && any(!is.na(pam_df[[metric]]))
      },
      logical(1)
    )
  ]
  skipped_metrics <- setdiff(metric_candidates, metric_cols)

  if (!length(metric_cols)) {
    stop("No comparable metrics with values on both sides were found.")
  }
  if (length(skipped_metrics)) {
    message(
      "Skipping metrics without values on both sides: ",
      paste(skipped_metrics, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  build_key <- function(df, cols) {
    build_row_key(df, cols)
  }

  py_tmp <- py_df
  pam_tmp <- pam_df
  py_tmp$.comparison_group <- build_key(py_tmp, key_cols)
  pam_tmp$.comparison_group <- build_key(pam_tmp, key_cols)
  py_tmp$.comparison_occurrence <- ave(
    seq_len(nrow(py_tmp)),
    py_tmp$.comparison_group,
    FUN = seq_along
  )
  pam_tmp$.comparison_occurrence <- ave(
    seq_len(nrow(pam_tmp)),
    pam_tmp$.comparison_group,
    FUN = seq_along
  )
  py_tmp$.comparison_key <- paste(
    py_tmp$.comparison_group,
    py_tmp$.comparison_occurrence,
    sep = "||rep="
  )
  pam_tmp$.comparison_key <- paste(
    pam_tmp$.comparison_group,
    pam_tmp$.comparison_occurrence,
    sep = "||rep="
  )

  py_cols <- c(".comparison_key", key_cols, metric_cols)
  pam_cols <- c(".comparison_key", metric_cols)
  py_tmp <- py_tmp[py_cols]
  pam_tmp <- pam_tmp[pam_cols]
  names(py_tmp)[names(py_tmp) %in% metric_cols] <- paste0(metric_cols, "_pyKinaXe")
  names(pam_tmp)[names(pam_tmp) %in% metric_cols] <- paste0(metric_cols, "_PamGeneAnalyzeR")

  comparison_df <- merge(py_tmp, pam_tmp, by = ".comparison_key", all = FALSE, sort = FALSE)
  comparison_df$.comparison_order <- match(comparison_df$.comparison_key, py_tmp$.comparison_key)
  comparison_df <- comparison_df[order(comparison_df$.comparison_order), , drop = FALSE]

  for (metric in metric_cols) {
    comparison_df[[paste0("diff_", metric)]] <-
      comparison_df[[paste0(metric, "_pyKinaXe")]] -
      comparison_df[[paste0(metric, "_PamGeneAnalyzeR")]]
  }

  comparison_df <- comparison_df[c(
    key_cols,
    unlist(lapply(metric_cols, function(metric) {
      c(
        paste0(metric, "_pyKinaXe"),
        paste0(metric, "_PamGeneAnalyzeR"),
        paste0("diff_", metric)
      )
    }))
  )]
  comparison_df$.comparison_order <- NULL

  if (!is.null(output_path)) {
    dir.create(dirname(output_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    write.csv(comparison_df, output_path, row.names = FALSE)
  }

  comparison_df
}
```

## Pipeline runtime
```{r}
pipeline_finished_at <- Sys.time()
pipeline_finished_proc <- proc.time()
pipeline_elapsed_wall_seconds <- as.numeric(difftime(
  pipeline_finished_at,
  pipeline_started_at,
  units = "secs"
))
pipeline_elapsed_cpu <- pipeline_finished_proc - pipeline_started_proc

pipeline_runtime <- data.frame(
  started_at = format(pipeline_started_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  finished_at = format(pipeline_finished_at, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
  wall_seconds = round(pipeline_elapsed_wall_seconds, 2),
  wall_minutes = round(pipeline_elapsed_wall_seconds / 60, 2),
  cpu_user_seconds = round(unname(pipeline_elapsed_cpu["user.self"]), 2),
  cpu_system_seconds = round(unname(pipeline_elapsed_cpu["sys.self"]), 2),
  cpu_elapsed_seconds = round(unname(pipeline_elapsed_cpu["elapsed"]), 2)
)

pipeline_runtime
```
